title: reading first: which text leads an order_to_cash build to roll up rows its own persona cannot read
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic); the maintainer set who files this epic's cards, verbatim: 「你应该负责立卡，对方只是派发处理」. The gap was reported by the dispatching seat `repo:objectstack#3` on #34659 (comment 6951773597), from area o3-F's five-repetition ask round on #34687; the filer did not re-read the records behind it.

## Why

Two builds of the same card, by a strong model, failed on the same publish finding and on nothing else. When every author walks into one trap, the trap is in what they were told: the card's wording or the skill's teaching of roll-ups.

## Evidence

- Per the report: two of two opus-low scratch builds of `order_to_cash` fail only on `security-rollup-source-unreadable`: `invoice.amount_paid` rolls up payments, which the `sales_rep` persona cannot read.

## Scope

- Reading: from the two transcripts, name the sentence the author followed, in the card or in `skills/objectstack-data` (roll-ups, security). Post it on this card.
- Then the fix where the sentence lives: the skill says a roll-up's source must be readable by every persona that reads the total, or the card states the personas' reads.

## Done when

- The reading is on the card, and a rebuild of `order_to_cash` no longer raises that finding for that reason.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Related: #34687. Suggested by the reporting seat: `domain:skills`, p2. A fix in `skills/**` is a governed surface.
